data.name: Shattered Body Gift
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Fortitude saves against poison and disease. Additionally, you require only half as much food and water as normal, and half as much rest as normal to gain a full night's sleep. However, you must still rest for at least 8 hours to prepare spells.|PrometheanShatteredBodyBonus
